agent.problem: Verse 19 uses "or" between the lion and bear picture and the house and snake picture. Saying the man "finally makes it into his house" turns them into one sequence and implies an escape from the bear that the text never gives.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives the length of Israel's time in the wilderness or a way to infer it. The baker can only guess among forty, seventy and twelve, so this blank tests an unseen detail rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
